title: A Conversation with Bertrand Russell (1952)
summary: A 1952 filmed interview in which Romney Wheeler talks with philosopher Bertrand Russell at his home in Surrey. Russell discusses his outlook and reflects on how the world changed over the first half of the century.
why: HN users share it as a chance to hear Russell speak himself and get a sense of his values and outlook.

quote.text: This is a wonderful interview with him that gives a great sense of what he was all about
